_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your values, OR set the JIRA_* variables in config.env. config.json is gitignored. The API token is NEVER stored here - it goes into AWS Secrets Manager (see notes below).

secrets_manager._comment: deploy.sh creates/updates this secret from the JIRA token you supply interactively or via the JIRA_API_TOKEN env var. The gateway credential provider reads it at setup time.
